cd /app && python3 -c "
from datasets import load_dataset
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
tok=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct')
ds=load_dataset('ryanmarten/OpenThoughts-1k-sample','metadata',split='train')
sci=ds.filter(lambda x: x['domain'] in ('physics','chemistry','biology'))
print(len(sci))
def cnt(texts): return sum(len(i) for i in tok([t for t in texts], add_special_tokens=False)['input_ids'])
r=cnt(sci['deepseek_reasoning']); s=cnt(sci['deepseek_solution'])
print('reason',r,'sol',s,'tot',r+s)
open('answer.txt','w').write(str(r+s))
" 2>&1 | tail -4; cat /app/answer.txt
